meta.authors: Jaroslav Tir, Philip Schafer, Paul F. Diehl, and Charles S. Gochman
meta.citation: Tir, J., Schafer, P., Diehl, P. F., & Gochman, C. S. (1998). 'Territorial Changes, 1816-1997.' Conflict Management and Peace Science.
meta.description: Documents all peaceful and violent transfers of sovereign territory between states from the Congress of Vienna (1816) through 2018.

procedures.label: Military Conquest / Armed Force
procedures.desc: Direct territorial acquisition achieved through military victory or armed occupation.

procedures.label: Annexation (Non-violent)
procedures.desc: Incorporation of external territory without direct major combat operations at transfer.

procedures.label: Cession / Bilateral Treaty
procedures.desc: Formal negotiated transfer between sovereign states via peace pact or diplomatic purchase.

procedures.label: Secession / Independence
procedures.desc: Separation of a territory or colony to establish sovereign statehood.

procedures.label: Unification / Fusion
procedures.desc: Voluntary political union or federation of previously sovereign entities.

procedures.label: Mandate / International Settlement
procedures.desc: Territorial reallocation governed by League of Nations, UN, or multilateral conference.

procedures.label: Other / Unspecified
procedures.desc: Complex or ambiguous historical transfer mechanism.
